items.exampleEn: The city will phase old buses out over the next five years.
items.exampleZh: 市政府會在未來五年內逐步淘汰舊公車。

items.exampleEn: Which dress did she pick out for the wedding?
items.exampleZh: 她挑了哪件洋裝去參加婚禮？

items.exampleEn: Two teams pulled out of the competition.
Nobody has put a better idea forward yet.
items.exampleZh: 目前還沒有人提出更好的點子。

items.exampleEn: The children put the model plane together in an hour.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們花了一個小時組裝好這架模型飛機。

items.exampleEn: We can't rule out rain this weekend.
items.exampleZh: 我們不能排除這個週末下雨的可能。

items.exampleEn: Someone ran my bike over in the parking lot.
items.exampleZh: 有人在停車場輾過了我的腳踏車。

items.sentenceEn: The meeting ran over by twenty minutes.

items.audioEn: Our office is phasing out paper forms, so from next month you'll need to fill them in online.
items.audioZh: 我們辦公室正在逐步淘汰紙本表格，所以從下個月起你得在網路上填寫。
items.questionZh: 從下個月起，表格要怎麼處理？
options: Mail the paper copies to the main office
Hand them to the front desk in person

items.sentenceEn: Can you pick the wrong words out for me?
items.sentenceZh: 你能幫我把用錯的字挑出來嗎？

items.sentenceEn: The high price rules the beach hotel out.
items.sentenceZh: 價格太高，海邊那家飯店只好不考慮了。

items.stemEn: At the meeting, several staff members ____ new ideas for saving energy.
items.stemZh: 會議上，好幾位員工提出了節省能源的新點子。

items.stemEn: My dad spent all evening ____ the new desk from the box of parts.
items.stemZh: 我爸爸花了一整晚，用那箱零件組裝新書桌。

items.passageEn: Our town's summer fair almost didn't happen this year. In May, the main sponsor, a local bank, pulled out because its budget had been cut. The organizers did not rule out canceling the fair, but first they put together a list of smaller businesses that might help. In the end, twelve shops agreed to give money. To save costs, they also decided to sell all the tickets online. The fair finally took place in August, and more people came than ever before.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上的夏季市集今年差點辦不成。五月時，主要贊助商——一家當地銀行——因為預算被刪減而退出。主辦單位沒有排除取消市集的可能，但他們先彙整了一份可能願意幫忙的小商家名單。最後，有十二家商店同意出錢。為了節省開支，他們也決定所有門票都改在網路上賣。市集最後在八月舉辦，來的人比以往都多。

questions.questionZh: 主要贊助商為什麼退出？
options: 主辦單位改在網路上賣票
延到明年再辦，改由十二家商店主辦
八月照常舉辦，人比以往多
取消了，因為找不到其他的贊助商

items.promptZh: 你可以幫我挑一份送給我媽媽的禮物嗎？
referenceEn: Can you help me pick out a gift for my mother?
Could you help me pick out a present for my mom?
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「挑選」（例如 pick out a gift、pick a gift out 等）；受詞可放在 out 的前面或後面
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 choose a gift、pick a gift、select a gift 等）
「可以…嗎」可寫，例如 Can you、Could you 等
「禮物」可寫，例如 gift、present 等；「媽媽」可寫，例如 mother、mom 等

items.promptZh: 因為工作太忙，她退出了這次的旅行計畫。
referenceEn: She pulled out of the trip because she was too busy at work.
Because work kept her too busy, she pulled out of the trip.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「退出」（例如 pulled out of the trip 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 dropped out of the trip、left the trip、cancelled the trip 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 pulled out、has pulled out 等）
「因為工作太忙」可寫，例如 because she was too busy at work 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：「會議超過了二十分鐘」有歧義（可讀成「會議開了二十多分鐘」），與 ran over by twenty minutes（比預定時間多開了二十分鐘）不符；建議「會議超時了二十分鐘。」或「會議比預定多開了二十分鐘。」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：中譯改為「會議超時了二十分鐘。」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：干擾項「拿出」本身就是 pull out 的常見義（pull out a wallet＝拿出錢包），雖非 glossZh 第一義「退出」，但學習者選它會被判錯而產生困惑；建議換成與 pull out 無關的詞義（如「撐過去」）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：干擾項「拿出」（pull out 的另一個常見意思）換成「出發」
